_note: NAMED SINGULARS register v1 (proposal, 2026-07-10) — the one-of-one places, artifacts, and wardens. Names grounded in docs/lore/WORLD-CHRONICLE.md + the EF Hunt source lore. kind: PLACE|ARTIFACT|WARDEN|RELIC. bindTo: where it attaches (zone/gate/asset). Weapon/armor ARTIFACTs are to be BOUND to existing hero gear art extracted from the MOBA client (owner 2026-07-10) — art refs TBD by the MOBA/website teams; names+legends are the proposal, owner to approve/edit.

places.name: The Shaft of Tianxia
places.legend: The wound where the deep first broke through; the only road down.

places.name: The Scholar's Gap
places.legend: The one pass through the rimwall; every book in Arcadia entered through it.

places.name: The Salt Gate
places.legend: Porthaven taxes the tide itself here.

places.name: The Carnival Shore
places.legend: Where the lights first came ashore, and never entirely left.

places.name: The Drowned Banquet
places.legend: Five flooded halls still set for a feast no one finished.

places.name: The Bastion of Dominus
places.legend: Seat of the Shadow Warden; its throne is still warm.

places.name: The Gardens of Enamora
places.legend: Perpetual twilight; everything blooms, nothing bears fruit.

places.name: The Midas Veins
places.legend: Gold-lust made mineral; the deeper you follow, the richer, and the less of you comes back.

places.name: The First Dock
places.legend: Every sea-lane in the world was measured from this pier.

places.name: The High Sanctum
places.legend: The stillest place in the world; the light asks nothing, and takes no one unready.

places.name: The Gateway Anchorage
places.legend: The first mooring above the clouds; ascent is earned here or nowhere.

places.name: The Grand Academy
places.legend: Arcadia's answer to every question except the one that opened the Shaft.

relics.name: The Blood Scimitar
relics.legend: The blade without peer: one cut, shoulder to shoulder, painless — the sacrifice you CHOOSE. Its cut is the only passage to the third deep: it does not kill you, it takes you to Luxuria.
relics.source: owner 2026-07-10 (the Scimitar of the Descent's true form)

relics.name: The Rice Bowl
relics.legend: Filled with mortal rice, it keeps you human in the deep. Empty it, lose it, and you are human no longer — hunted by the world you came from, one of the haunting instead of the haunted, and the way above closes to you forever.
relics.source: owner 2026-07-10 (the humanity anchor of the Descent)

relics.name: The Harlequin Mask
relics.legend: It laughs so you don't have to.

relics.name: The Plague Doctor Mask
relics.legend: It has seen every ending and treated none.

relics.name: The Lunar Moth Mask
relics.legend: Drawn to what it cannot hold.

relics.name: The Sigil of Binding
relics.legend: The knot that holds the dark below. Do not untie it.

artifacts.name: Dawnbreaker
artifacts.legend: Forged in Emberfall of storm-aether and first light; it has never been drawn at night.

artifacts.name: Tidechain
artifacts.legend: A Porthaven harbor-chain blessed by every tide it ever held back.

artifacts.name: Petalfall
artifacts.legend: A Mythoria festival bow; its arrows land soft as blossom and twice as final.

artifacts.name: The Lantern of the Way
artifacts.legend: Lit at the Shaft's mouth in the Second Age; it has not gone out.

artifacts.name: The Aegis of Empyrea
artifacts.legend: It refuses no blow and resents none.

artifacts.name: The Covet Crown
artifacts.legend: A circlet of Covet Crystal. Power for essence. Read the fine print.

wardens.name: the Lake That Watches
wardens.legend: Second lock; it drowned its own name.

wardens.name: the Inferno Champion
wardens.legend: Final lock; the vault's own desire, armored.

wardens.name: the Shaft-Guardian
wardens.legend: It faces DOWN, not up. Think about that.

wardens.name: the Storm Warden of Emberfall
wardens.legend: Tests courage by being exactly worth fearing.
